source: NASA JPL Horizons System (ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/horizons), target 502 Europa, observer Earth geocenter
note: Computed ephemeris (a prediction from orbits), not a measurement. Archived snapshot. Light time is one-way, Europa to Earth.

fields.distanceAU: Earth-Europa distance, astronomical units (1 AU = Earth-Sun distance)
fields.oneWayLightMinutes: minutes a radio signal takes from Europa to Earth
fields.sunElongationDeg: angle between the Sun and Europa as seen from Earth; small = Europa is behind/near the Sun, radio contact is hard
